content:
Reddit (RDDT) stock closed 9.3% higher on Wednesday at $158.10, and the news behind it came from a research desk rather than from Reddit. The argument was that the worst outcome for two of its data licensing contracts is already in the price. That put a price on the cheaper half of Reddit’s AI question. The expensive half is untouched.

Reddit Jumped On A Note About Its Two Licensing Deals

The size of the move belonged to Reddit alone. The S&P 500 gained 0.4% over the same window and Meta Platforms (META) 2.5%, while Pinterest (PINS) ended 0.1% lower, so this was not a rally that swept up everything social. Baird’s note said the market has already discounted the worst outcome for Reddit’s two AI data licensing agreements, both of which come up for renewal in 2027. No new business figure arrived with it. What repriced was a fear.

But Reddit Has A Second AI Problem That The Note Left Alone

Licensing is not where Reddit earns. Advertising brought in $762 million of the $805 million of revenue in Q2 2026, about 95% of the total, and revenue has now grown at over 60% for an eighth consecutive quarter. Management’s own line on the renewals is that the range of outcomes is wide and the deals are not binary, since Reddit’s content gets used for training, for grounding and as a search index.

The harder problem sits on the other side of that trade. The AI systems buying Reddit’s conversations are the same ones changing how people find them. By management’s own account, AI Overviews has yet to deliver what ten blue links did, and a decline in search referrals cancelled out the daily users its product work added. As of Q2 2026 Reddit’s own visibility into that referral traffic was low. The note repriced the contracts. It left the traffic alone.

So What Are You Actually Betting On At This Price?

Reddit carries about $30 billion of market value on $2.78 billion of revenue over the past twelve months. Even after Wednesday, the stock trades about 42% below its 52-week high of $270.71 and about 30% above its 52-week low of $121.84. The gap to the high prices something more awkward than a renewal: whether Reddit can build a direct audience faster than search takes one away. Reddit reaches over half a billion people a week and more than 130 million a day, against a goal of 1 billion daily users globally.

That daily figure is the one to follow, because the direct users inside it are the part Reddit controls. An analyst note can lift the price in a session and leave that daily figure exactly where it stood.

chineseTitle: 你是否应该购买 Reddit 股票，因为它的更新风险已经被定价？
chineseSummary: Reddit (RDDT) 股价周三收盘上涨 9.3%，至 158.10 美元，其背后的消息来自研究部门，而不是 Reddit。争论的焦点是，其两份数据许可合同的最糟糕结果已经体现在价格中。这给 Reddit 人工智能问题中便宜的一半定价了。昂贵的一半没有动过。
chineseContent:
Reddit (RDDT) 股价周三收盘上涨 9.3%，至 158.10 美元，其背后的消息来自研究部门，而不是 Reddit。争论的焦点是，其两份数据许可合同的最糟糕结果已经体现在价格中。这就给 Reddit 上的人工智能问题中便宜的一半定价了。昂贵的一半没有动过。

Reddit 对其两项授权交易发表了评论

此举的规模只属于Reddit。标准普尔 500 指数在同一窗口内上涨 0.4%，Meta Platforms (META) 上涨 2.5%，而 Pinterest (PINS) 收盘下跌 0.1%，因此这并不是一场席卷所有社交媒体的反弹。 Baird 的报告称，市场已经对 Reddit 的两项人工智能数据许可协议的最坏结果进行了折扣，这两项协议均将于 2027 年续签。但没有带来新的业务数据。重新定价的是一种恐惧。

但 Reddit 还有第二个人工智能问题，该注释未提及

Reddit 并不是靠授权来赚钱的。 2026 年第二季度 8.05 亿美元的收入中，广告收入为 7.62 亿美元，约占总收入的 95%，目前收入已连续第八个季度增长超过 60%。管理层对续约的看法是，结果的范围很广，而且交易不是二元的，因为 Reddit 的内容被用于培训、基础和搜索索引。

更困难的问题位​​于贸易的另一边。购买 Reddit 对话的人工智能系统也改变了人们找到它们的方式。根据管理层的说法，AI Overviews 尚未达到十个蓝色链接的效果，而且搜索推荐量的下降抵消了其产品工作所增加的每日用户数量。截至 2026 年第二季度，Reddit 自己对推荐流量的可见度很低。该票据重新定价了合同。它留下了交通。

那么，您实际上在这个价格上押注什么呢？

过去 12 个月，Reddit 的市值约为 300 亿美元，收入为 27.8 亿美元。即使在周三之后，该股的交易价格仍比 270.71 美元的 52 周高点低约 42%，比 121.84 美元的 52 周低点高约 30%。与高价格的差距比续约更尴尬：Reddit 能否比搜索更快地建立直接受众群体。 Reddit 每周覆盖超过 5 亿人，每天覆盖超过 1.3 亿人，而全球每日用户的目标是 10 亿。

这个每日数字是值得关注的，因为其中的直接用户是 Reddit 控制的部分。分析师的报告可以在一个交易日内提升价格，并将每日数据保持在原位。
